subject: general
question: Reena runs at a speed of 8 km/h. How long will she take to cover 200 m?
solution:
**Given:**

Speed = 8 km/h

Distance = 200 m

**Formula used:**

Time = Distance / Speed

**Calculation:**

Convert speed from km/h to m/s:

⇒ Speed = 8 × (5/18) m/s

⇒ Speed = 40/18 m/s

⇒ Speed = 20/9 m/s

Time = Distance / Speed

⇒ Time = 200 / (20/9)

⇒ Time = 200 × (9/20)

⇒ Time = 9 × 10

⇒ Time = 90 seconds

**∴ The correct answer is option 3.**
